purpose: Resolve the 21 formerly unmapped direct portable implementation-evidence gaps into explicit current source-level implementation status without converting source presence into row qualification, production handler, persistence, native, human, psychometric, SME, or external closure.

classification_semantics.IMPLEMENTED: Required behavior is materially present in the recovered current canonical portable source. This does not imply fresh row-specific qualification or production binding.
classification_semantics.PARTIALLY_IMPLEMENTED: Substantial required behavior exists in current canonical portable source, but at least one material acceptance facet is absent or unproven.
classification_semantics.SPECIFICATION_ONLY: Current owner/component/interface/acceptance specification exists, but no executable behavior satisfying the requirement was located in the recovered current canonical source.
classification_semantics.GENUINELY_MISSING: Neither meaningful executable behavior nor a current buildable owner/component/acceptance specification exists.

method.scope: learning_core + curriculum_core + shared_ports + current traceability/spec evidence
method.qualification_boundary: The code-delta subject is not a standalone complete repository checkout; an isolated REBIND test invocation cannot run because unchanged source files are absent from the delta reconstruction. Classification therefore uses direct source behavior plus existing qualification provenance, and does not claim fresh row-specific test closure.

rows.evidence_found: Resumable research-plan/dossier/source acquisition and research-grounded course jobs exist.
rows.remaining_gap: No Chat/conversation collaboration surface or mode-switch binding was located in the canonical extracted source.

rows.evidence_found: MASTERY_CHECK is an executable mode; answer reveal raises IntegrityPolicyViolation; assisted/revealed attempts are excluded from mastery evidence.
rows.remaining_gap: Fresh row-specific qualification and production handler/persistence binding remain open.

rows.evidence_found: Confidence is explicitly specified as separate self-report state.
rows.remaining_gap: No confidence/self-confidence model, service, persistence field, or executable behavior was located in the 66 reconstructed canonical source files.

rows.evidence_found: Attempts bind skill, criterion, item, mode, assistance, answer-reveal and timestamp; mastery projection counts independent criterion-linked evidence and excludes integrity-breaking evidence.
rows.remaining_gap: Fresh row-specific qualification and production handler/persistence binding remain open.

rows.evidence_found: Construct-preserving accommodation behavior and recording are fully specified.
rows.remaining_gap: No accommodation field, policy, attempt condition, or executable accommodation behavior was located in canonical extracted source.

rows.remaining_gap: No LearningJobProjectionAdapter/projection contract proving navigation/relaunch survival and equality to canonical job state was located.

rows.evidence_found: Fail-before-evidence semantics for disallowed offline assessment are specified.

rows.remaining_gap: No single comprehensive LearningReadinessService/preflight was located that covers every required dependency and returns the specified actionable typed recovery contract.

rows.remaining_gap: No explicit indexed reverse SourceClaimMap was located that directly returns all affected lessons/claims for a changed/retracted source under the exact acceptance criterion.

rows.evidence_found: Blocking contradiction/unresolved-claim semantics are specified.
rows.remaining_gap: No contradiction or unresolved-claim state/gate was located in canonical extracted source.

rows.remaining_gap: No general activation gate was located that verifies both answer key and scoring/rubric rule for every mastery-check item; exact CV-024/CV-025 vectors remain specified-unexecuted.

rows.evidence_found: ALLOWED/DENIED/UNKNOWN fail-closed rights/offline semantics are specified.
rows.remaining_gap: No content-rights/license/expiry/offline export/cache eligibility implementation was located in canonical extracted source.

rows.evidence_found: Executable accessibility preflight can block on missing text-equivalent/nonpointer/conformance requirements.
rows.remaining_gap: No artifact-by-artifact captions/transcripts/alt-description/interaction-alternative completeness inventory or exact READY gate was located; CV-031/CV-032 remain specified-unexecuted.

rows.evidence_found: INTERRUPTED/resume/restart/invalidate semantics are specified.
rows.remaining_gap: No assessment-attempt interruption state machine, response journal, resume policy, or integrity-resume logic was located in canonical extracted source; generic job crash recovery is not equivalent.

rows.evidence_found: Field justification and external-reference separation are specified.
rows.remaining_gap: No Learning data-minimization adapter, field inventory policy, or executable copy-vs-reference enforcement was located in canonical extracted source.
